```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
#| label: data
#| include: false
picks <- dbReadTable(con, "picks")
roster <- dbReadTable(con, "roster")
coaches <- dbReadTable(con, "coaches")
nfl_rosters <- dbReadTable(con, "nfl_rosters")
nfl_draft_picks <- dbReadTable(con, "nfl_draft_picks")
# thousands-separated formatter for inline numbers in the narrative
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
```

## 1. Introduction

A head coach is one voice on a staff, so what the data can support is an
association, the head coaches under whom a future draftee played, and this
post maps that landscape: how many coaches produced draftees, at which
positions, how concentrated the output is, and how much the answer depends
on the counting rule.

## 2. Data

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-30. The roster
records start in 2010, so this post covers draft classes from 2011 on, and
the coach landscape uses classes from 2014 on, where every draftee's
observable career is plausibly complete.*
:::

### 2.1 The two counting rules differ only in how much of the pre-draft career each one covers

The table defines the two rules; under either, every head coach recorded
for a season counts, interim and midseason coaches included, and players
whose athlete id was recycled across two careers are excluded.

```{r}
#| label: rules-table
tibble::tribble(
  ~rule                                          , ~what_it_counts                              , ~names ,
  "Last school"                                  , "The player's final season before the draft" ,
  "Whoever finished the product"                 ,
  "Every season"                                 , "Every season the player played, once each"  ,
  "Everyone who oversaw part of the development"
) |>
  kable(
    caption = "The two counting rules. One roster season is enough under either rule."
  )
```

### 2.2 The two rules name the same coach set for barely half of recent picks

Because transfers move draftees between programs, the table and the first
figure show the two rules naming the identical coach set for only about
half of picks since 2014, and the second figure ties the decline to the
share of draftees who played for more than one school; every count after
this section uses the last-school rule.

```{r}
#| label: rules-compute
#| include: false
reused <- reused_ids(roster)
# pool of pre-draft roster seasons for every eligible pick: reused below
pool <- picks |>
  filter(!is.na(playerId), year >= 2011, !playerId %in% reused) |>
  distinct(playerId, year, overall) |>
  inner_join(
    distinct(roster, playerId, season, team),
    by = "playerId",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  filter(season < year)
last_school <- link_coaches_picks(
  picks,
  roster,
  coaches,
  rule = "last",
  reused = reused
)
every_season <- link_coaches_picks(
  picks,
  roster,
  coaches,
  rule = "any",
  reused = reused
)
set_overlap <- function(y, o) {
  a <- last_school$coach_id[last_school$year == y & last_school$overall == o]
  b <- every_season$coach_id[every_season$year == y & every_season$overall == o]
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
}
keys <- distinct(last_school, year, overall)
ovl <- keys |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(ovl = set_overlap(year, overall)) |>
  ungroup()
by_class <- ovl |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    identical_share = mean(ovl == 1),
    n_picks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# transfer flag: a draftee whose pre-draft seasons span more than one team
pool_teams <- pool |>
  group_by(year, overall) |>
  summarise(n_teams = n_distinct(team), .groups = "drop")
xfer_share <- ovl |>
  left_join(pool_teams, by = c("year", "overall")) |>
  mutate(transferred = n_teams > 1) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(share = mean(transferred), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
#| label: rules-overlap-table
by_class |>
  left_join(xfer_share, by = "year") |>
  filter(year %in% c(2011, 2014, 2017, 2020, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026)) |>
  transmute(
    `Draft class` = year,
    Picks = n_picks,
    `Same coach set under both rules` = pct(identical_share, 0),
    `Draftees who played for more than one school` = pct(share, 0)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Picks whose coach set is identical under both rules, and the share of draftees with a multi-school college career, selected draft classes.")
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 Three in four head coaches active since 2013 produced a draftee, and the rest mostly had short tenures

```{r}
#| label: universe-nums
#| include: false
n_coaches_all <- n_distinct(coaches$coach_name)
n_coach_seasons <- nrow(coaches)
active <- coaches |>
  filter(season >= 2013) |>
  distinct(coach_id, coach_name)
producers <- last_school |>
  filter(year >= 2014) |>
  distinct(coach_id, coach_name)
# seasons coached in the window whose players feed the 2014 to 2026 classes
tenure <- coaches |>
  filter(season >= 2013, season <= 2025) |>
  distinct(coach_id, season) |>
  count(coach_id, name = "seasons") |>
  mutate(
    produced = coach_id %in% producers$coach_id,
    tenure_bin = cut(
      seasons,
      breaks = c(0, 1, 3, 6, 13),
      labels = c("1 season", "2 to 3 seasons", "4 to 6 seasons", "7 or more seasons")
    )
  )
tenure_tab <- tenure |>
  group_by(tenure_bin) |>
  summarise(coaches = n(), producers = sum(produced), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(share = producers / coaches)
```

Of the `r fmt(n_coaches_all)` head coaches in the data, back to
`r min(coaches$season)`, the table counts the `r fmt(nrow(active))` active
since 2013 and the `r fmt(nrow(producers))` (`r pct(nrow(producers) / nrow(active), 0)`)
who produced a draftee in the 2014 and later classes; the figure shows the
share rising with the number of seasons a coach held the job.

```{r}
#| label: universe
tibble::tribble(
  ~group                                                  , ~coaches        ,
  "Head coaches in the data, 1886 to 2026"                , n_coaches_all   ,
  "Head coaches active from the 2013 season on"           , nrow(active)    ,
  "Of those, coaches with a draftee in the 2014 classes on" , nrow(producers)
) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c("Group", "Coaches"),
    caption = "The head-coach universe and the draftee-producing subset."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: universe-fig
#| fig-height: 4.5
p_tenure <- ggplot(tenure_tab, aes(100 * share, tenure_bin)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = tenure_bin == "1 season",
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %d of %d coaches produced a draftee (%.0f%%)",
        tenure_bin, producers, coaches, 100 * share
      ),
      data_id = tenure_bin
    ),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%% (%d of %d)", 100 * share, producers, coaches)),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 4.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "#1b4f8a"), guide = "none") +
  expand_limits(x = 118) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  labs(
    title = "Coaches without a draftee mostly held the job briefly",
    subtitle = "Share of head coaches active from 2013 on who produced a draftee, by seasons coached through 2025",
    x = "Coaches with at least one draftee",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_tenure, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 4.5)
```

```{r}
#| label: universe-pin
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  n_coaches_all == 1814,
  nrow(producers) == 305,
  all(producers$coach_id %in% active$coach_id),
  round(100 * nrow(producers) / nrow(active)) == 73,
  # the figure's title and heading: the share rises with tenure, and most
  # coaches without a draftee coached three seasons or fewer
  all(diff(tenure_tab$share) > 0),
  with(tenure, mean(seasons[!produced] <= 3)) > 0.75
)
```

### 3.2 Quarterback draftees are the smallest share of the draft among field positions

```{r}
#| label: position-groups
pos_groups <- c(
  "Quarterback" = "QB",
  "Running Back" = "RB",
  "Fullback" = "RB",
  "Wide Receiver" = "WR/TE",
  "Tight End" = "WR/TE",
  "Offensive Tackle" = "OL",
  "Offensive Guard" = "OL",
  "Center" = "OL",
  "Defensive End" = "DL",
  "Defensive Edge" = "DL",
  "Defensive Tackle" = "DL",
  "Outside Linebacker" = "LB",
  "Inside Linebacker" = "LB",
  "Linebacker" = "LB",
  "Cornerback" = "DB",
  "Safety" = "DB",
  "Place Kicker" = "ST",
  "Punter" = "ST",
  "Long Snapper" = "ST"
)
pos_links <- last_school |>
  filter(year >= 2014) |>
  mutate(pos_grp = unname(pos_groups[position]))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(pos_links$pos_grp)))
pos_grp_summary <- pos_links |>
  distinct(year, overall, coach_id, coach_name, pos_grp) |>
  summarise(
    draftees = n(),
    coaches = n_distinct(coach_id),
    .by = pos_grp
  ) |>
  mutate(
    per_coach = draftees / coaches,
    share = draftees / sum(draftees),
    pos_grp = reorder(pos_grp, share)
  )
qb_row <- pos_grp_summary[pos_grp_summary$pos_grp == "QB", ]
qb_draftees <- qb_row$draftees
qb_coaches <- qb_row$coaches
qb_share <- qb_row$share
qb_per_coach <- qb_row$per_coach
```

The table and the first figure compare position groups as shares of all
draftees: quarterbacks are the smallest field-position group,
`r fmt(qb_draftees)` draftees (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * qb_share)`) from
`r fmt(qb_coaches)` coaches, about `r sprintf("%.1f", qb_per_coach)` per
coach against roughly 3 for defensive backs and receivers; the second
figure shows every coach's count in each group.

```{r}
#| label: position-table
group_names <- c(
  QB = "Quarterback", RB = "Running back", `WR/TE` = "Receiver or tight end",
  OL = "Offensive line", DL = "Defensive line", LB = "Linebacker",
  DB = "Defensive back", ST = "Special teams"
)
pos_grp_summary |>
  arrange(desc(share)) |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = unname(group_names[as.character(pos_grp)]),
    Draftees = draftees,
    Coaches = coaches,
    `Draftees per coach` = sprintf("%.1f", per_coach),
    `Share of all draftees` = pct(share)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Draftees by position group, 2014 classes on, last-school rule. A draftee counts once per head coach of his final college season.")
```

### 3.3 Undrafted entry shrinks the quarterback share, it does not grow it

```{r}
#| label: udfa
nfl_groups <- c(
  QB = "QB",
  RB = "RB",
  FB = "RB",
  WR = "WR/TE",
  TE = "WR/TE",
  T = "OL",
  G = "OL",
  C = "OL",
  DE = "DL",
  DT = "DL",
  NT = "DL",
  DL = "DL",
  OLB = "LB",
  ILB = "LB",
  MLB = "LB",
  LB = "LB",
  CB = "DB",
  S = "DB",
  FS = "DB",
  SS = "DB",
  DB = "DB",
  K = "ST",
  P = "ST",
  LS = "ST",
  KR = "ST",
  PR = "ST"
)
# rookie-roster entries, split by whether the id ever appears in the draft
rookie_entries <- nfl_rosters |>
  filter(season == rookie_year, rookie_year >= 2014) |>
  distinct(gsis_id, position, rookie_year) |>
  filter(!is.na(gsis_id), !is.na(position)) |>
  as.data.frame()
drafted_ids <- nfl_draft_picks |>
  distinct(gsis_id) |>
  filter(!is.na(gsis_id)) |>
  pull(gsis_id)
entry_split <- rookie_entries |>
  mutate(g = unname(nfl_groups[position])) |>
  filter(!is.na(g)) |>
  mutate(route = if_else(gsis_id %in% drafted_ids, "Drafted", "Undrafted"))
entry_shares <- entry_split |>
  count(g, route, name = "n") |>
  group_by(route) |>
  mutate(share = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()
n_undrafted <- sum(entry_shares$n[entry_shares$route == "Undrafted"])
n_drafted <- sum(entry_shares$n[entry_shares$route == "Drafted"])
pick_order <- entry_shares |>
  filter(route == "Drafted") |>
  arrange(desc(share)) |>
  pull(g)
qb_share_dr <- entry_shares$share[
  entry_shares$g == "QB" & entry_shares$route == "Drafted"
]
qb_share_ud <- entry_shares$share[
  entry_shares$g == "QB" & entry_shares$route == "Undrafted"
]
entry_shares <- entry_shares |>
  mutate(g = factor(g, levels = rev(pick_order)))
```

Among NFL rookies (an undrafted entrant is a rookie-roster player whose id
never appears in the draft record), the table and the first figure show the
quarterback share falling from `r sprintf("%.1f%%", qb_share_dr)` of
drafted rookies to `r sprintf("%.1f%%", qb_share_ud)` of undrafted ones,
while receivers and specialists take larger undrafted shares; the second
figure follows the quarterback share rookie class by rookie class.

```{r}
#| label: udfa-table
entry_shares |>
  mutate(cell = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", fmt(n), share)) |>
  select(g, route, cell) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = route, values_from = cell) |>
  arrange(desc(g)) |>
  transmute(`Position group` = unname(group_names[as.character(g)]), Drafted, Undrafted) |>
  kable(caption = "NFL rookies by position group and entry route, 2014 rookie classes on; the percentage is the share of that route's rookies.")
```

### 3.4 A fifth of recent draftees belong to ten coaches

```{r}

top10_n <- sum(coach_totals$draftees[1:10])
total_pairs <- sum(coach_totals$draftees)
top10_share <- top10_n / total_pairs
saban_total <- coach_totals$draftees[coach_totals$coach_name == "Nick Saban"]
```

The table and the first figure list the coaches with the most draftees,

have five or fewer draftees.

### 3.5 Each top coach's draftee mix leans a different direction

```{r}
#| label: positions-nums
```

### 3.6 Most draftee-producing coaches ran a single program

```{r}
#| label: movers-nums
#| include: false
teams_per_coach <- coaches |>
  distinct(coach_id, school) |>
  count(coach_id, name = "n_teams") |>
  left_join(producers, by = "coach_id") |>
  filter(coach_name %in% coach_totals$coach_name) |>
  count(n_teams, name = "coaches")
movers <- c(
  "Lincoln Riley",
  "Brian Kelly",
  "Kalen DeBoer",
  "Lane Kiffin",
  "Steve Sarkisian",
  "Mario Cristobal",
  "Josh Heupel",
  "Jimbo Fisher"
)
mover_detail <- pos_links |>
  filter(coach_name %in% movers) |>
  group_by(coach_name, team) |>
  summarise(
    draftees = n(),
    first_class = min(year),
    last_class = max(year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(draftees))
mover_get <- function(coach, team) {
  mover_detail$draftees[
    mover_detail$coach_name == coach & mover_detail$team == team
  ]
}
kelly_total <- sum(mover_detail$draftees[mover_detail$coach_name == "Brian Kelly"])
kelly_nd <- mover_get("Brian Kelly", "Notre Dame")
kelly_lsu <- mover_get("Brian Kelly", "LSU")
kiffin_om <- mover_get("Lane Kiffin", "Ole Miss")
kiffin_fa <- mover_get("Lane Kiffin", "Florida Atlantic")
kiffin_usc <- mover_get("Lane Kiffin", "USC")
team_colors <- dbReadTable(con, "teams") |>
  distinct(team, color)
```

The first table shows `r teams_per_coach$coaches[teams_per_coach$n_teams == 1]`
of `r sum(teams_per_coach$coaches)` producing coaches ran a single program,
so a coach's count is usually a program's count; the second table and the
figure split eight multi-program coaches by school, where Brian Kelly's
draftees divide `r kelly_nd` and `r kelly_lsu` between Notre Dame and LSU
while Lane Kiffin's `r kiffin_om` at Ole Miss dwarf his
`r kiffin_fa` each at Florida Atlantic and USC.

## 4. Summary

The head-coach landscape behind recent draft picks is broad at the base and
narrow at the top, and every count in it depends on the counting rule.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tibble::tribble(
  ~Finding                                              , ~Evidence                                                                                                                               ,
  "The counting rule matters for half of recent picks"  , sprintf("%s of picks since 2014 name the same coaches under both rules.", pct(window_mean, 0))                                       ,
  "Most active coaches produced a draftee"              , sprintf("%s of %s head coaches active from 2013 on.", fmt(nrow(producers)), fmt(nrow(active)))                                      ,
  "Quarterbacks are the smallest field-position share"  , sprintf("%s of draftees, about %.1f per coach.", pct(qb_share), qb_per_coach)                                                        ,
  "Undrafted entry shrinks the quarterback share"       , sprintf("%.1f%% of drafted rookies, %.1f%% of undrafted ones.", qb_share_dr, qb_share_ud)                                            ,
  "Ten coaches hold a fifth of draftees"                , sprintf("%s of %s draftee-coach pairs; Saban leads with %d.", fmt(top10_n), fmt(total_pairs), saban_total)                          ,
  "Most producing coaches ran one program"              , sprintf("%d of %d.", teams_per_coach$coaches[teams_per_coach$n_teams == 1], sum(teams_per_coach$coaches))
) |>
  kable(caption = "The findings and the numbers behind them.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
The two counting rules answer different questions and neither is the right
one in the abstract.

- The last-school rule names whoever finished a draftee's college career;
  the every-season rule names everyone who oversaw part of it.
- Nearly half of recent picks name a different coach set depending on which
  question is being asked, so any coach ranking built on draft picks owes
  the reader its counting rule.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
A head coach is associated with a draftee, not solely responsible for him.

- CFBD records head coaches only: no assistant coaches, no coordinators, no
  strength staff.
- The true apprenticeship picture, the Saban tree of coordinators who became
  head coaches, cannot be built from this source, and doing it would mean
  finding one that does.
:::

Several caveats bound these numbers.

- The coach landscape uses classes of 2014 and later, so coaches whose
  draftees came mostly earlier are invisible here.
- The transfer flag is broad, spanning any multi-team pre-draft career
  rather than portal-era transfers specifically.
- The undrafted route counts NFL rookie-roster appearances, so drafted
  players who never reached an NFL roster are absent from both sides of
  that comparison, and undrafted players are identified by the absence of
  a draft pick, which also sweeps in a handful of non-draft entry paths.
- Draftees are a selected group: they come disproportionately from programs
  that recruit well, so coach-level counts conflate the coach with the
  program until a recruiting control or a same-coach-different-school
  comparison is added. Those extensions are queued as followups.
